requirements.outcome: Colored event fills lane bounds; lower name band turns black on selection.
Left drag moves events to matching Audio widths with transport snap settings and ghost/opaque preview.
White lower edge handles trim non-destructively and update audible source bounds.
White fade handles at both ends produce visible and audible fades.
White gain handle changes event amplitude with dB feedback and easy unity snap.
Event changes save/reopen and undo/redo without modifying source media.
Dark menu strip matches current dark panel background with white text.
Release startup avoids white/console flashing before the app frame.
